title: Kiln native mod manifest (native.json), format 1
description: One per native mod folder (library/native/<id>/<version>+<hash8>/, kiln/native/<id>/ on a server or as a drop-in). Describes DLL mods Kiln loads with LoadLibrary: plain DLL mods (no init) and Kiln-aware ones (init export, native/core/abi/kiln_native.h). Comments and trailing commas are allowed. Unknown keys are kept and warned about.

side.description: Where it loads. Default client (most DLL mods are client mods; a hosting client runs the world).

clients.description: Default from side: server -> none, client/both -> mod.

dlls.description: DLLs in the folder (subfolders allowed), loaded in this order.

phase.description: kiln_native.h: early (start of kiln_boot, also in safe idle), boot (after Kiln plugins, no hooks needed), world (first world step, needs hooks), dllmain (loaded by the proxy in DllMain; chain.ini [profile]).

init.description: Export of dlls[0] called as int init(const KilnNativeContext*) right after it loads. null: only loaded. Not allowed with phase dllmain.

after.description: Native mods to load before this one, when present (ordering only).

before.description: Native mods to load after this one, when present.

requires.description: Native mods that must be present and load first; else this one fails.

enabled.description: Default state; <configDir>/native.json and the profile entry override it.

kiln.description: Kiln versions this mod works with (checked like a 'kiln' dependency).

builds.description: Game exe sha256s the mod was made for. When given and the running exe is not listed, the mod still loads with a warning (status note 'untested build').

updates.description: Where new versions of the mod are published, for the launcher's and `kiln updates check`'s update notice (a notice and a link: Kiln never downloads or installs a version by itself). A tagged union by provider; each provider takes only its own properties. Never a reason to refuse a mod: a value Kiln can't read is ignored with a warning (KL103), and a provider this Kiln does not know means "update checks unsupported". Docs: docs/kiln/modding/manifest.md, "updates".

provider.description: github (releases of a public repository) or nexus (one file of a Nexus Mods page).

repository.description: owner/repo on github.com. Not a URL.

tagPattern.description: The tag of a release, with {version} exactly once where the version stands: v{version}, or mods/my-mod/v{version} in a repository of several mods. A tag counts only when it matches from its first to its last character and the version is a semantic version. No wildcards.

asset.description: The file name of the mod's zip in a release, with {version} at most once (the version as the tag spells it): my-mod-{version}.zip. Leave it out when the release carries a kiln-release.json (kiln publish writes one): it names the zip.

channel.description: stable: releases that are not marked pre-release and whose version has no pre-release part. prerelease: those too.

gameId.description: Enshrouded's game id on Nexus Mods.

modId.description: The number of the mod's page (.../enshrouded/mods/<modId>).

fileChainId.description: The id of the file whose versions are followed (the file itself, which keeps its id from upload to upload; not the id of one version, and not the page's main file by default).
